title: Jimi language (Cameroon) - Wikipedia
text: Jimi (Djimi), also known as Jimjimən and 'Um Falin, is a Chadic language spoken in Cameroon in Far North Province on the Nigerian border in and around Bourrha. Dialects are Djimi, Jimo, Malabu, Wadi, and Zumo. The Gude use the term Fali to refer to the Jimi, which means 'slave' in several languages of the area.
